schema.text: If you have a disabled parking permit: how often are the reserved spaces at your destination occupied by others or missing?
schema.help: A disabled parking permit is the official card that allows parking in spaces reserved for people with disabilities.

options.text: I don't have a disabled parking permit

en.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: If you have a disabled parking permit: how often are the reserved spaces at your destination occupied by others or missing?
en.#A disabled parking permit is the offici: A disabled parking permit is the official card that allows parking in spaces reserved for people with disabilities.
en.#I don't have a disabled parking permit: I don't have a disabled parking permit

it.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: Se hai il contrassegno per persone con disabilità: quanto spesso i posti riservati a destinazione sono occupati da altri o mancano del tutto?
it.#A disabled parking permit is the offici: Il contrassegno per persone con disabilità è il permesso ufficiale che consente di parcheggiare nei posti riservati alle persone con disabilità.
it.#I don't have a disabled parking permit: Non ho il contrassegno per persone con disabilità

fr.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: Si vous avez une carte de stationnement pour personnes handicapées : à quelle fréquence les places réservées à destination sont-elles occupées par d'autres ou inexistantes ?
fr.#A disabled parking permit is the offici: La carte de stationnement pour personnes handicapées est le document officiel qui permet de se garer sur les places réservées aux personnes handicapées.
fr.#I don't have a disabled parking permit: Je n'ai pas de carte de stationnement pour personnes handicapées

de.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: Wenn Sie einen Parkausweis für Menschen mit Behinderung haben: Wie oft sind die reservierten Plätze an Ihrem Ziel von anderen belegt oder gar nicht vorhanden?
de.#A disabled parking permit is the offici: Der Parkausweis für Menschen mit Behinderung ist der amtliche Ausweis, mit dem man auf den für Menschen mit Behinderung reservierten Plätzen parken darf.
de.#I don't have a disabled parking permit: Ich habe keinen Parkausweis für Menschen mit Behinderung

tr.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: Engelli park kartınız varsa: gittiğiniz yerdeki ayrılmış park yerleri ne sıklıkla başkaları tarafından işgal ediliyor veya hiç bulunmuyor?
tr.#A disabled parking permit is the offici: Engelli park kartı, engelli kişilere ayrılmış yerlere park etmeye izin veren resmi karttır.

fa.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: اگر کارت پارک ویژهٔ افراد دارای معلولیت دارید: هر چند وقت یک بار جاهای پارک ویژه در مقصد توسط دیگران اشغال شده‌اند یا اصلاً وجود ندارند؟
fa.#A disabled parking permit is the offici: کارت پارک ویژهٔ افراد دارای معلولیت کارت رسمی است که اجازهٔ پارک در جاهای ویژهٔ افراد دارای معلولیت را می‌دهد.
fa.#I don't have a disabled parking permit: کارت پارک ویژهٔ افراد دارای معلولیت ندارم

hu.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: Ha van mozgáskorlátozott parkolási igazolványa: milyen gyakran foglalják el mások a fenntartott helyeket az úti célján, vagy hiányoznak teljesen?
hu.#A disabled parking permit is the offici: A mozgáskorlátozott parkolási igazolvány az a hivatalos kártya, amellyel a mozgáskorlátozottak számára fenntartott helyeken lehet parkolni.

ar.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: إذا كانت لديك بطاقة ركن لذوي الإعاقة: كم مرة تكون الأماكن المخصصة عند وجهتك مشغولة من قبل آخرين أو غير موجودة؟
ar.#A disabled parking permit is the offici: بطاقة الركن لذوي الإعاقة هي البطاقة الرسمية التي تسمح بالركن في الأماكن المخصصة للأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة.
ar.#I don't have a disabled parking permit: ليست لدي بطاقة ركن لذوي الإعاقة
